The references in `docs/references.md` are expected to change. Use this template to propose
a new one or to challenge an existing one.

**Which rule in the kit does this touch?**
(File and line, or the rule's text. Example: `CLAUDE.md` §Routing rule 1, "Recon first".)

**The reference**
- Citation (authors, title, year):
- Link (arXiv, DOI or publisher page — it must resolve to a real page):

**What it found, in one or two lines**

**What should change in the kit because of it**
(Keep the rule · reword it · change a threshold in `rules/thresholds.json` · drop it.)
